description:
The Cyber Security Engineering Vulnerability and Threat Management Team is seeking a highly motivated and innovative Automation Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise automation solutions that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance service quality across the organisation.
 You will be working closely with security, infrastructure, engineering, and business teams to identify automation opportunities, develop scalable solutions, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires validated software engineering expertise, modern cloud development experience, and a passion for leveraging automation and emerging technologies to tackle sophisticated operational challenges.
 Key responsibilities
 Develop automation for vulnerability remediation, patch deployment, configuration compliance, and orchestration activities.
 Design, develop, test, deploy, and streamline operational and technology processes.
 Build automation workflows for infrastructure management, security remediation, configuration management, and operational support activities.
 Develop scalable software solutions, APIs, services, and web-based applications that enable operational efficiency and process optimisation.
 Design and implement integrations between enterprise applications, cloud services, infrastructure platforms, and third-party tools.
 Build and maintain reusable automation frameworks, modules, scripts, and tooling.
 Collaborate across teams including operation find opportunities for automation and process improvement.
 Support CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices to enable efficient software delivery and deployment automation.
 Ensure all solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, and aligned with governance standards.
 Produce high-quality documentation, operational runbooks, and support materials.
 Explore and evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and machine learning capabilities, to enhance automation outcomes
 
 Required Skills and Experience
 Security Automation & Vulnerability Management
 Good understanding of infrastructure vulnerability management processes.
 Vulnerability assessment concepts
 Risk and severity scoring methodologies
 Patch management lifecycles
 Remediation practices
 Experience developing automation for:
 Vulnerability remediation
 Automated patching
 Configuration management
 Compliance validation
 Infrastructure orchestration
 Strong software engineering experience with TypeScript.
 Experience with Python and scripting languages including Shell and Bash.
 Experience with Rust or other low-level programming languages is desirable.
 Experience building and supporting full-stack solutions, including:
 Web applications
 APIs and microservices
 CI/CD tooling
 Automation platforms
 Low-level software and integrations
 Expertise in software development standard methodologies, object-oriented design principles, and secure coding methodologies.
 Knowledge of common algorithms and data structures used for processing and managing large datasets.
 
 API Development & Integration
 Experience designing, developing, and integrating:
 REST APIs
 GraphQL APIs
 Security, authentication, authorisation, and secret management.
 Experience working with OAuth, API keys, tokens, certificates, and secure credential handling.
 
 Cloud & Platform Engineering
 Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, particularly:
 Microsoft Azure
 Amazon Web Services (AWS)
 Experience developing cloud-native automation solutions and services.
 Practical experience with:
 Docker
 Kubernetes
 Container orchestration platforms
 Understanding of modern infrastructure and platform engineering principles.
 
 Automation & DevOps
 Experience building automation solutions for operational and infrastructure processes.
 Experience with:
 Azure DevOps
 GitHub Actions
 Jenkins
 Git-based source control platforms
 Experience developing orchestration workflows, operational tooling, and automated deployment solutions.
 Ability to create and maintain automation runbooks, remediation workflows, and self-healing operational processes.
 
 Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies
 Knowledge of modern AI technologies and their practical application within enterprise environments.
 Understanding of:
 Generative AI
 Large Language Models (LLMs)
 Prompt Engineering
 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 AI Agents and agentic workflows
 Experience integrating AI capabilities into automation solutions is helpful.
 
 Testing, Quality & Governance
 Experience implementing automated testing and validation approaches.
 Knowledge of software quality assurance and release management practices.
 Understanding of security, governance, compliance, and operational risk requirements
 
 Personal skills and capabilities:
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
 Ability to communicate technical concepts optimally to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Demonstrable ability to work collaboratively within multi-functional teams.
 Strong internal customer management and relationship-building capability.
 Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.
 Demonstrates innovation, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset.
 Able to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 Committed to delivering high-quality, secure, and reliable solutions.
 Takes ownership of outcomes and demonstrates energy, initiative and a bias for action.
 Act as a role model and promote behaviours in keeping with the Mission & Values of the organisation
 Adapts quickly to changing priorities, technologies and threats, and is willing to work across adjacent security domains.
 Challenges outdated practices constructively and identifies sustainable improvements to systems and processes.
 Invests in continuous learning, develops deep craft expertise and helps raise capability across the team.
 Produces clear, formal and accurate documentation and status reporting.

 Preferred Qualifications
 Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related difficulty, or equivalent practical experience.
 Relevant certifications in cloud computing, software engineering, DevOps, automation, cybersecurity, or AI technologies.
 Experience working within large-scale enterprise, cloud, or security-focused environments.

 London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 
 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
 
 LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
 
 Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership , Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
 
 Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
 
 We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
 
 You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
 
 LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
